verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Turn to me, O turn, and be saved
Says the Lord, for I am God

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
There is no other
None beside me
I call your name

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
I am God who comforts you
Who are you to be afraid

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Of flesh that fades is made like the grass of the field
Soon to wither

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Listen to me my people
Give ear to me, my nation

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
A law will go forth from me
And my justice for a light to the people

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines:
Lift up your eyes to the heavens
And look at the earth down below

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines:
The heavens will vanish like smoke
And the earth will wear out like a garment
